pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal, dark-pigmented regions with defined angular vertices. Patches exhibit sharp edge gradients and occupy the majority of the spatial area relative to the light-toned inter-patch spacing.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, narrow light-toned pathways forming a closed-cell topological graph. Junctions primarily consist of tri-node intersections with uniform pixel width across the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the superior neck and shoulder margin, representing a dense mane structure.
